title: Colors
intro: Takere green stands for care and action; navy, for trust. Always use the tokens — never raw hex values — so dark mode works automatically.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Green for primary actions and highlights; navy for navigation and institutional surfaces.

neutral.title: Neutrals
neutral.description: Backgrounds, surfaces, text and borders. They change between light and dark.

status.title: Status
status.description: Communicate outcome or urgency. Always paired with an icon or text.

care.title: Care types
care.description: Identify categories of care plan items (habits, diet, cold).

palette.title: Institutional palette
palette.description: Colors from the brand file (Design/Header). Use them in print, apparel and graphic pieces; in interfaces, use the tokens above.

heroui.title: HeroUI bridge
heroui.description: HeroUI variables point to Takere tokens, so Button, Chip, Alert and other components ship with brand colors out of the box.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Each token becomes a Tailwind class (bg-, text-, border-…) and is also available as a CSS variable.

guidelines.do1: Use primary for a single main action per area.
guidelines.do2: Pair status colors with an icon and text.
guidelines.do3: Use semantic tokens (takere-surface, takere-text) to support dark mode.
guidelines.dont1: Don't hardcode hex values in components.
guidelines.dont2: Don't use danger red for decoration.
guidelines.dont3: Don't put small primary-green text on white — use primary strong.
